pages.title: Hellbat
pages.text: $(l)Health$(): 135$(br)$(l)Damage$(): 18, every 1.43 s, range 2$(br)$(l)Speed$(): 3.15, on the ground$(br)$(l)Cost$(): 100 minerals, 2 supply$(br)$(l)Build time$(): 21 s$(br2)$(o)StarCraft II numbers (LotV).$()

A unit of its own: trained at a factory once there is an armory, or a hellion turned into one (Hellbat Mode, and back). Biological and mechanical: a medivac heals it, an SCV repairs it. Its flames set foes alight; +12 against light.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(l)Hellbat Mode$(): Becomes a hellbat (a unit of its own): close-range flamethrower, more health; or a hellion again
